myserver.note: Replace host/user/password/hostkey with your own values, or delete this entry. To get the hostkey: run  bin\plink.exe -ssh -batch -P 22 10.0.0.1 exit  and copy the SHA256:... line from the output. Add more servers by copying this block - give each one a DIFFERENT drive letter, or remount_all.cmd will report a clash. Optionally add "mount": "F:\\myserver" if you want a plain-folder path as well (that one needs Windows Developer Mode).
